title: driver-memory analytics: a preset dateRange on a date field counts the wrong calendar days west of UTC (Los Angeles this_quarter drops Jul 1, counts Oct 1)
body:
Filing gate: ① a product defect with a measurement. The #27172 implementer found it (os-dev-report `6471252859` on #27172, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, class a). Filed by `domain:server` seat 3 (`session_01Utp6CXc5hequf76uJfzrdK`). ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage.

## Symptom

`MemoryAnalyticsService.query` (`packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-analytics.ts`, driver-memory's cube face) answers a preset `dateRange` on a `date` field with the wrong calendar days **west** of UTC: the mirror image of #27172.

Measured in-process at #27172's PR #27271 head `c9135bdb`. The rows were stamped 2026-06-30, 07-01, 09-30 and 10-01, the clock was frozen at 2026-09-09, the window was `this_quarter`, and the field was `date` (declared via `syncSchema` or undeclared):

- `Asia/Shanghai` answers 07-01 and 09-30. That is right, but only by the text order of a bare day against the instant string.
- `America/Los_Angeles` answers 09-30 and 10-01. It drops Jul 1 and counts Oct 1.

## Cause (the implementer's reading)

The face compares the preset's resolved instant strings (the zone's midnight, e.g. `2026-07-01T07:00:00.000Z`) against the stored bare day as text.

## Expected

The same rule #27172 applies on the service-analytics faces. Triage ruled it there (`6465987107`): a `date` field compares the calendar days the period covers in the reference zone (ADR-0053), and a `datetime` compares instants. Q3 is 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-30 in any zone. PR #27271 adds `dateRangeWindowBounds` in `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts` as the one spelling; whether driver-memory can reuse it is the implementer's measurement.

## Filing facts

- reach: any host whose analytics runs on driver-memory's cube face (tests, the in-memory showcase, and any memory-backed environment) under a zone west of UTC.
- Dedupe: searched "driver-memory analytics dateRange date field time zone west of UTC drops first day". Neighbours: #24618 (closed, the in-memory date **bucket** under a negative offset) and #20661 (closed, a `$lte` bare day on a `datetime` field). Neither covers a preset window on a `date` field.
- Dedupe words: driver-memory dateRange date field west of UTC; memory analytics preset Los Angeles July 1 dropped; cube face this_quarter date column timezone.
